ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first AI agent that conducts preventative health triage and links rural community health workers with local clinic resources.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the AI for Good mandate by focusing on rural healthcare access, drawing from the success of multilingual health awareness bots that win impact hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that detects unauthorized industrial waste dumping and land encroachment near protected zones.
ideas.title: EcoAudit Satellite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines environmental sustainability with hard visual evidence, giving judges a live, map-based interface with clear, measurable impact metrics.

ideas.pitch: An AI coordination platform that pairs lonely seniors in local communities with vetted volunteer drivers for grocery runs and social outings.
ideas.title: ElderCircle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Won a grand prize at a similar global good hackathon because it addresses social isolation with a highly practical matching and scheduling workflow.

ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced multimodal lost-and-found portal optimized for large university campuses using automated visual matching and real-time mapping.
ideas.title: CampusLoop
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built for a university fest environment, it solves an immediate, relatable campus pain point with a working, highly polished live demo.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight computer vision tool using smartphone camera feeds on local transit to flag infrastructure wear, track obstacles, and log issues for municipal action.
ideas.title: CivicRail Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced computer vision applied to public safety, creating concrete economic and social value for municipal infrastructure maintenance.
